title: The Sunlit Man
summary: A mysterious man known only as Nomad—formerly Sigzil, a Knight Radiant of the Skybreakers and Hoid's apprentice—flees across the Cosmere pursued by the relentless Night Brigade. He crash-lands on Canticle, a world that orbits so close to its sun that civilization survives only by constantly moving across the surface on a massive train track, staying just ahead of the scorching dawn. Bound by a Dawnshard that prevents him from harming others, Nomad must use his wits, his spren Auxiliary, and the desperate ingenuity of Canticle's people to survive the planet's tyrannical Cinder King. A race against the sun itself, this story explores the cost of running from one's past and what it truly means to be a man of peace in a universe that demands violence.
archiveDescription: This accession records the experiences of a fugitive from the Rosharan system on the world of Canticle, a planet whose extreme orbital proximity to its sun forces civilization into perpetual motion across a global railway. The document provides valuable data on investiture mechanics across planetary boundaries, particularly the behavior of a Nahel bond and a Dawnshard Command in an unfamiliar investiture environment. The record also offers rare insight into the organizational structures that pursue individuals across the Cosmere and the consequences of the events recorded in the Rosharan chronicles.
